Aspen Acres, Custer County. Transfer of command from CIMT (NR Team 6) to CIMT (RM Team 3) will occur 
tomorrow. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior. Numerous residences 
threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (RM 
Team 2) to CIMT (RM Team 1) will occur today. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with flanking, backing and creeping. Numerous structures and critical infrastructure 
threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area 
yesterday. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 8). Seven miles northwest of 
Lake City, CO. Timber, heavy slash and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, single tree torching and 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (CA Team 8) back to the local unit 
will occur today. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. Minimal fire behavior 
with creeping, isolated torching and smoldering. Residences and communication infrastructure threatened. 
Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Fishhook, Medicine Bow-Routt NF, USFS. Eight miles southeast of Steamboat Springs, CO. Grass, brush and 
timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Keystone, White River Field Office, BLM. Forty-five miles northwest of Meeker, CO. Brush, timber and 
dormant brush. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Residences threatened. 
 
Fuhr Gulch, Moffat County. Three miles southwest of Craig, CO. Brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior.
